questions.qtext: The rake angle in a twist drill

options.text: varies from minimum near the dead centre to a maximum at periphery.
is maximum at dead centre and zero at the periphery.
is constant at every point of cutting edge.
is function of the size of the chisel edge.

questions.solution:
(a)
Rake angle of a twist drill is the angle of the flute in relation to the work. The rake angle varies
from minimum near the dead centre to a maximum at the periphery.

questions.qtext:
In a CNC program block,
N0020 G03 G91 X20 Z20..., G03 and G91 refers to

options.text: circular interpolation in CW direction and absolute dimension
circular interpolation in CCW direction and absolute dimension
circular interpolation in CW direction and incremental dimension
circular interpolation in CCW direction and incremental dimension

questions.solution:
(d)
A G-code determines the type of operation performed on the machine. G codes select the type of motion, speed or feed mode, etc. The codes G03 and G91 refers respectively for the circular interpolation in CCW direction and incremental dimension.

questions.qtext: Which of the following statements are correct regarding electrochemical grinding?

options.text: A copper bonded alumina grinding wheel acts as the cathode and the workpiece as the anode.
A rubber bonded alumina grinding wheel acts as the cathode and the workpiece as the anode.
Metal removal takes place due to the pressure applied by the grinding wheel only.
Metal removal takes place due to electrolysis.

questions.solution:
(a, d)
In electrochemical grinding, a copper bonded alumina grinding wheel acts as the cathode and the workpiece as the anode. The majority of metal removal in ECG is by electrolytic action and typically less than 5% of metal is removed by the abrasive action of the wheel.

questions.qtext: Which of the following statements are correct about Plasma Arc Machining (PAM)?

options.text: In PAM, the metal is removed by melting and vapourization.
Plasma can produce very high temperature.
Plasma arc cutting is not used for electrically conductive metals.
Wider kerf is produced by plasma arc cutting.

questions.solution:
(a, b)
In plasma arc machining, the gases are ionized by placing an arc across the path of the gas flow. The gas molecules get dissociated causing large amounts of thermal energy to be liberated. This generates temperature of the order of 16500°C. Which are then utilized in removing metal by melting and vapourization. It is used only for electrically conductive metals. This process is fast, the kerf width is small and the surface finish is good.
